a.lede: Ethernet will keep your devices connecting online in record time, while Wi-Fi keeps them untethered. But how well can they both work together?
a.title: Should you have both Ethernet and Wi-Fi for your home?

b.lede: Joining two Ethernet cables together with a coupler is rare, but when your cords are suddenly too short, there are better options to extend your network.
b.title: Why you might not want to join two Ethernet cables (and what you should do instead)
